author: The Current
description:
Tommy Brennan of 'Saturday Night Live' on Motion City Soundtrack
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

St. Paul's Tommy Brennan of 'Saturday Night Live' is set to host the opening event at Mystic Lake Amphitheater, titled “Setting the Stage: An Evening of Minnesota Music, Comedy & Community,” set for Saturday, June 20. The event features a lineup of Minnesota musicians; specifically Motion City Soundtrack, Ber, Morris Day and the Time, the country-rock band Rocket Club, students from School of Rock, and DJ Jake Rudh.

In an interview with The Current's Jill Riley, Brennan talked about his fandom of Motion City Soundtrack, and he also speculates on what might be the overall ethos of Minnesota emo pop punk. "It's probably nicer," Brennan says.

See more of what Brennan has to say in the video above, and find Jill's interview with Tommy Brennan, along with more information about the Mystic Lake Amphitheater opening event, posted at thecurrent.org.
title: SNL's Tommy Brennan shares his thoughts about Motion City Soundtrack

author: The Current
description:
Watch a performance of "Aerial Troubles" by Stereolab, recorded live in Minneapolis in October 2025
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Stereolab have long held the ability to paradoxically both defy and define musical genres. Since forming in 1990, Stereolab have consistently demonstrated a penchant of artfully blending a variety of musical expressions to create something wholly different. It’s that quality that has made Stereolab one of the most influential bands to emerge from the nascent decade of alternative music — and it’s their innovative nature that keeps them at the forefront of musical invention and experimentation.

Stereolab’s most recent album is 2025’s Instant Holograms on Metal Film. Five months after that album’s release, Stereolab found themselves at the storied Minneapolis music venue First Avenue, where they performed to a sold-out room filled with enthusiastic fans.
